display.purpose: Large page, drawer, and dialog headings.

body.purpose: Readable forms, explanations, and card content.

playful.purpose: Welcome, loading, empty, and completion states.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, metadata, navigation, and compact language labels.

shadows.name: quiet-nav
shadows.purpose: Separates pill navigation from the atmospheric page.

shadows.name: list-lift
shadows.purpose: Adds restrained lift to actionable rows.

shadows.name: drawer-edge
shadows.purpose: Places a drawer above the page.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default affirmative action for management forms.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { padding: .7rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #315f89; border-radius: .65rem; color: white; background: #315f89; font: 750 1rem Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .2s, background .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #264f73; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(64,117,166,.28); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet cancel or supporting action beside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { padding: .7rem 1rem; border: 1px solid rgba(49,95,137,.4); border-radius: .65rem; color: #315f89; background: rgba(255,255,255,.72); font: 750 1rem Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s, transform .2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.92); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(64,117,166,.28); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Management Input
components.description: A readable field for deck and card details.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: .35rem; color: #405c73; font: 700 .86rem Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: .72rem .8rem; border: 1px solid rgba(64,117,166,.36); border-radius: .55rem; color: #20394e; background: rgba(255,255,255,.86); font: 400 1rem Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #4075a6; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(64,117,166,.28); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Compact uppercase navigation inside a translucent pill.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; height: 3rem; align-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(64,117,166,.16); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.62); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(47,78,105,.08); } .ds-nav a { position: relative; display: flex; height: 100%; align-items: center; padding: 0 .75rem; color: rgba(0,0,0,.7); font: 700 .72rem Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #ff3e00; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(64,117,166,.28); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav .ds-active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: calc(50% - 6px); bottom: 0; left: calc(50% - 6px); border-bottom: 3px solid #4075a6; }

components.name: Language Switch
components.description: A tactile segmented control for the shared English and Japanese workspace.
components.css: .ds-language { display: inline-flex; gap: .25rem; padding: .25rem; border: 1px solid rgba(64,117,166,.22); border-radius: .9rem; background: rgba(255,255,255,.52); } .ds-language button { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .45rem; padding: .55rem .8rem; border: 0; border-radius: .65rem; color: #39546c; background: transparent; font: 700 1rem Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-language button:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.7); } .ds-language button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(64,117,166,.28); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-language .ds-selected { color: white; background: #4075a6; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(38,74,107,.18); } .ds-language span { font: 700 .68rem 'Fira Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; opacity: .72; }

components.name: Management Row
components.description: A mostly-flat actionable resource row with a blue leading edge.
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 1rem; align-items: center; padding: 1rem 1.1rem; border: 1px solid rgba(64,117,166,.2); border-left: 4px solid #4075a6; border-radius: .8rem; background: rgba(255,255,255,.68); box-shadow: 0 7px 24px rgba(47,78,105,.07); color: rgba(0,0,0,.7); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-row h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.08rem; } .ds-row p { margin: .35rem 0 0; color: #60788c; font-size: .88rem; } .ds-row a { color: #315f89; font-weight: 750; text-decoration: none; } .ds-row a:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-row a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(64,117,166,.28); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Study Card
components.description: The signature portrait card with compact metadata chips and centered vocabulary.
components.css: .ds-study-card { position: relative; width: 280px; min-height: 360px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 1rem 1rem 2.5rem; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(64,117,166,.18); border-radius: 8px; background: white; color: rgba(0,0,0,.7); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-study-card:hover { border-color: rgba(64,117,166,.36); } .ds-study-card h2 { margin: 3rem 0 .5rem; font-size: 1.75rem; text-align: center; } .ds-study-card p { margin: 0; text-align: center; opacity: .8; } .ds-study-card small { position: absolute; bottom: 10px; left: 10px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: #f3f4f6; } .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-chips span { padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: #f3f4f6; font-size: 12px; }

narrative.overview:
The interface should feel like sitting down with a small, familiar set of study cards: direct, friendly, and ready for a short daily session. Its cool blue atmosphere lowers visual pressure, while rounded controls and physical flip-and-swipe behavior keep the experience tactile and lightweight.

This is a practical personal tool, not a dense corporate dashboard. The visual system favors a clear task at the center, modest supporting information, and components that communicate state through shape, color, and movement without surrounding the user with panels or metrics.
keyCharacteristics: Cool, calm blue atmosphere with translucent paper-like surfaces.
Friendly, lightweight composition with one clear task at a time.
Tactile and playful cards, controls, pills, flips, and swipes.
Editorial headings used selectively against a plain, practical body face.
Mostly-flat depth: borders and tonal separation first, shadows only where layering needs proof.

rules.name: The Blue Table Rule
rules.body: Study Blue establishes the workspace; signal colors mark an action or state and must not become competing page themes.

rules.name: The One Editorial Moment Rule
rules.body: Let the largest page or panel heading carry the serif voice; keep operational content plain and immediately readable.

rules.name: The Mostly-Flat Rule
rules.body: Use border and tone for ordinary grouping; add a shadow only when an element is actionable, selected, or physically above another surface.

dos: Do keep one study task or management decision visually dominant on each screen.
Do use Study Blue, cool borders, and paper surfaces as the default working vocabulary.
Do reserve pronounced shadows for selected states and true overlays.
Do preserve the card flip-before-answer behavior and tactile swipe feedback.
Do let pills, subtle lift, and short transitions add playfulness without adding visual noise.
donts: Don't turn the interface into a dense dashboard of metrics, panels, or competing controls.
Don't replace the calm blue atmosphere with multiple equally dominant accent colors.
Don't use the editorial display face for dense forms or long operational copy.
Don't add shadows to every bordered surface; grouping should remain mostly flat.
Don't trade the personal, lightweight character for generic enterprise styling.
